structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun-launched token ("ONE ACCELERATIONISM DOLLAR" / $e/dollar, contract 2BhV3a...pump) graduated to PumpSwap and is only ~11-20 minutes old at detection. It spiked +399% on the hour and +308% in the last 5 minutes alone, with h1 volume ($937k-$972k) roughly 20x its own market cap in one hour. Txn counts are enormous for the token's age (3,700+ buys/sells in h1; 1,153 unique buyers vs 924 unique sellers per GeckoTerminal). GMGN wallet data shows heavy bundler presence (233 bundler wallets, 22% top-bundler-trader share) plus 34 sniper wallets and 215 fresh wallets - a launch-frenzy pattern typical of pump.fun graduations rather than organic discovery. Structurally it looks clean: mint/freeze renounced, LP 100% locked, RugCheck score 1 (very low), top10 holders ex-AMM only 11.5%, no honeypot/tax flags. A same-name/ticker competitor (Ea4g4Gv...) exists but was created ~3.5 minutes later and now sits at $0 liquidity with negligible volume - this token is the one actually being traded.

narrative.description: Rides the 'e/acc' (effective accelerationism) tech-philosophy meme - a real, recurring internet/tech-Twitter ideology about pro-technology, pro-progress acceleration - repackaged as a 'dollar'/currency-themed token with generic space-launch marketing copy ('Ignition,' 'Propulsion,' 'Escape Velocity'). No specific breaking news event, launch trigger, or identifiable KOL catalyst was found in the time available.
narrative.why_spreading: Web search surfaced no posts, threads or discussion referencing this contract, ticker or project name specifically (search engines index X/Twitter poorly, so absence is not conclusive proof of no discussion). The only observable 'spread' is on-chain: extreme, front-loaded volume and price action consistent with bot/sniper/bundler-driven pump.fun graduation mechanics rather than evidence of organic cross-community attention. A separate, unrelated 'E/ACC' (Effective Accelerationism) token already exists on Solana with its own ~$96k market cap per Coinbase/Solflare listings, meaning the underlying meme is already fragmented across tokens rather than uniquely captured here.

token_connection.why_this_token: This contract is the first-created instance of the 'ONE ACCELERATIONISM DOLLAR'/e/dollar name+ticker pair (pair_created_at_ms earlier by ~3.5 minutes than the copycat) and is the only one with real liquidity, volume and holders - the copycat (Ea4g4Gv...) has $0 liquidity and ~$1 of hourly volume, i.e. effectively dead. So within this exact name/ticker, this is the canonical, currently-trading token.
token_connection.competing_tokens: One direct name/ticker copycat found in the packet (dead, $0 liquidity). Separately, an unrelated but same-meme token 'E/ACC' (Effective Accelerationism, different symbol/contract) already exists with ~$96k market cap, meaning the broader 'e/acc' narrative is split across multiple unrelated tokens rather than concentrated in this one.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN shows 233 bundler wallets (22% of top-bundler trader volume), 34 sniper wallets, and 215 fresh wallets among ~1,000 holders; derived buys-per-unique-buyer of 3.19 in h1 indicates meaningful repeat/churned trading rather than pure organic one-and-done buying. Volume-to-market-cap turnover of ~20x in one hour on a token only ~15 minutes old is a hallmark of pump.fun launch-bot/sniper activity. No dexscreener paid ads/boosts/trending-bar flags were true in the packet, and no KOL or call-channel promotion was found via search - but that search coverage was limited (no X access).

structural_risks: Only $47-48k total liquidity against a $250-260k market cap - thin relative to the stated cap, meaning even moderate sell pressure moves price sharply
233 bundler wallets and 34 sniper wallets likely hold cheap early supply that can be dumped into strength
High turnover (buys-per-buyer 3.19, ~20x hourly volume/mcap) suggests a large share of volume is churn/bot activity rather than durable new demand
Price has already risen +399% (h1) / +308% (m5) before entry, meaning a late buyer is entering near a already-extended local high, not at the base of a move

structured_output.counterargument: The bearish read (already-exhausted pump, heavy bundler/sniper overhang, no organic narrative found) could be wrong: the m5-vs-h1 volume acceleration ratio (6.7x) shows buying pressure was still intensifying at the moment of detection, not fading, and unique buyers (1,153) meaningfully exceed unique sellers (924) with clean structural fundamentals (locked LP, renounced authorities, low top10 concentration, RugCheck score 1). Pump.fun graduations with this much raw participation sometimes continue running on momentum/FOMO alone for another leg even without any external narrative catalyst, and the absence of X discussion in my search may simply reflect the token's extreme youth (created just ~19 minutes before entry) rather than true absence of organic interest that hasn't yet been indexed.

structured_output.thesis: This is a very young (~15-20 min) pump.fun graduate that has already run +300-400% before entry, driven by heavy bundler/sniper/fresh-wallet activity and extreme turnover rather than any confirmed organic narrative - no X/Twitter, Telegram, Reddit or news discussion was found in the time available, though X coverage is inherently weak. Structure is clean (locked LP, renounced authorities, low concentration, RugCheck score 1), so outright liquidity-pull rug risk is low, but a late entry into an already-extended, bot/insider-heavy pump has meaningful downside risk of hitting -50% before +100% as early bundlers/snipers take profit. It is the canonical token for its exact name/ticker (the copycat is dead), which is a mild positive, but the underlying 'e/acc' meme is fragmented across unrelated tokens, weakening any claim to unique narrative capture.
